content:
owen: Heads up — started seeing intermittent gRPC stream stalls between pods in eu-west after yesterday's kernel rollout. Affected KServe/gpu pods doing long-lived streams. Stalls are ~500ms-2s and show up every few seconds during heavy batches. Anyone else?

maya: yep seeing it on the gpu-pool too. logs show repeated `rpc: stream read timeout` and some recoveries. Thought drivers at first but pattern matches node-to-node traffic. :thinking_face: 

luis: did a quick tcpdump on node-egress-3 -> node-ingest-7 during a stall. saw lots of `ICMP frag needed` and then TCP retransmits. snippet: ```14:22:11.123456 IP 10.40.2.11 > 10.40.7.22: Flags [.], seq 12345:12600, proto TCP, length 255 ``` followed by `ICMP destination unreachable (fragmentation needed)` from the TOR. PMTU between those nodes is 1450 (geneve+vxlan overhead).

anita: ah — we pushed a calico/geneve config change + kube-proxy netfilter fix in that rollout. encapsulation added ~50 bytes on some paths. Some hosts kept mtu 1500, others got clamped earlier in path -> fragmentation. gRPC uses large messages and we have GSO/GRO on, so kernel tries to offload and downstream sees fragments and drops mid-stream.

maya: interesting — I also saw out-of-order acks and checksum errors on one node's `dmesg`: `NETDEV: skb: checksum wrong, possible fragmentation`

sana: quick triage plan: 1) enable tcp_mtu_probing on affected nodes (`sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1`) 2) temporarily clamp MTU on kube-interfaces to 1450 where geneve present 3) as a mitigation flip off GSO/GRO on NICs for the gpu-pool to avoid kernel offload reassembly issues. thoughts?

luis: +1 for MTU clamp while we do root cause. Also suggest checking iptables NAT/masquerade — we saw path change when kube-proxy toggled MASQUERADE earlier which can cause a different path with lower MTU.

owen: can someone run the quick commands on eu-west pool? I can coordinate rollback window if needed. Proposed commands: ```# probe PMTU sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1 # clamp interface MTU sudo ip link set dev eth0 mtu 1450 # disable offloads sudo ethtool -K eth0 gro off gso off tso off ```

kernel-bot: kernel-rollback scheduled for node-egress-3 at 23:30 UTC per onboarded plan (if mitigation fails).

anita: I've started a canary: clamped mtu on 2 nodes and disabled GSO on gpu pods — stream stalls dropped to near-zero in 10m of load testing. rolling this to rest of affected nodes now.

sana: will follow up with a postmortem draft (assigning to networking infra) and include prompts to add MTU validation in our node-autorepair checks.

owen: thanks team — keep updates here. If rollback still needed we'll do it in the 23:30 window. :thumbsup:
